question: Related Questions Q. Hajj 3526 views Q. Can we perform Umra by wearing Ihram from Masjid Ayesh in Macca for the 2nd Umra? 6410 views Q. Last year during HAJJ, a strange incident took place during my SAII of umrah. I had performed HAJJ-E-QIRAN. As i reached makkah at mid-night and we had to leave for MINA the next day, i decided to perform my umrah immediately without taking any rest. During my SAII, I started feeling very exhausted towards the end and i got confused with the count.After thinking over i was sure that i had completed all the 7 shawts of SAII BUT still as i did not want to take a chance i decided to continue from safa to marwa and back. As i walked towards marwah and crossed 30 percent distance i got so exhausted and sleepy that i was certain i would collapse. i was seeing safa and was worryig how i would walk upto safa and then back upto marwah. After a few seconds even before i could cross 50 percent distance towards safa i was forced to close my eyes and i thought i was going to fall. When i opened my eyes i was ascending marwah. I was amazed and did not know what happened. How coulf i have walked one and a half shawts of SAII without realizing anything. It all happened in a blink of my eye. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 151225 Country: india Title: touched kaba unknowingly while tawaf.. Question: When I went for umrah to Makkah and I was doing tawaf I touched Hajr-e-Aswad with my hand as I didn’t know that perfumed is applied to Hajr-e-Aswad. Since I touched it unknowingly, does I have to give dam that is do I have to sacrifice animal for that. If dam has to be given, I am going for umrah this year in-shaAllah, can I give dam for that. Answer ID: 151225 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 971/984/H=9/1438) If the scent of perfume touched your hand then dam became wajib. And if it did not touch your hand then in this case though no dam is wajib but a long time had passed over it hence it is better when you visit Makkah again slaughter a goat with the intention of dam and distribute its meat among the poor and needy ones. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
